rationale: The second leg subtracts a growth rate (GROWTH(at,1)) from a level ratio (R&D+ad/sale) with no scale reconciliation, so the "off-balance-sheet gap" is mechanically dominated by whichever component has wider dispersion, and the resulting signal is essentially a bundle of three well-known anomalies (gross/operating profitability, R&D intensity, and low asset growth) rather than a new interaction.

Algebraically this reduces to approximately rank(cash-margin trend)×(rank RD + rank GW) − rank GW, which is very close to the already-tested "Internal Intangibles over Goodwill Profit" with a cash-trend substituted for the profitability level, and it also largely duplicates the Acquired Intangible Cash Decay proposal in this same batch.

This is a cosmetic recombination of two archive signals — "Lagged Intangible Profit Dollar Payoff" (profit-dollar change scaled by assets × lagged intangible intensity) and "Intangible Gross-Margin Upgrade" (margin improvement × operating margin × lagged intangible intensity) — with gross-profit dollars swapped in for operating-profit dollars.

The cost-mix rotation (rising intangible spend share against falling COGS burden) is a genuinely different construct from prior margin-level or margin-change legs and the sign logic is internally consistent, though the differencing of two trends on incomparable scales is crude and the direction sits in tension with the archive's "Intangible Harvest Operating Leverage," which rewarded *falling* intangible intensity.

TS_COUNT(xrd)/TS_COUNT(xad) on unimputed fields is a reporting-availability count, so the signal is precisely the disclosure proxy the reasoning claims to avoid, and it is near-binary (mostly 0 or 5) making the multiplicative intangible leg a coverage artifact layered onto an own-history profitability rank already tried in "Goodwill-Light Intangible Cash High."

The expected negative sign matches the expression's natural direction, and replacing the accrual margin change with a cash-margin trend plus netting internal intangible formation out of goodwill intensity is a substantive attempt to fix the fmb/alpha disagreement in "Goodwill Margin Decay," though it overlaps materially with the Cash Source Validation Spread submitted alongside it.
